Scene study

Inspect the descent.

This reference uses the homepage scene and content to inspect its scroll transitions in context. Scroll from orbit through the atmosphere to the landing reveal. It is not a separate learning activity. Reduced motion keeps the scene still. If WebGL is unavailable, a gradient background and usable page content remain available; graphics performance has not been established across devices.

The history of possibility

How technology expanded what one person can create.

1661–1662 · Before industrialization

A craft took years to master.

Making something meant learning its tools, techniques, and trade.

1913 · Industrialization

Machines multiplied output.

Mechanization and assembly lines brought speed and scale to production.

1984 · Personal computing

Many tools. One computer.

Writing, designing, calculating, and building became possible on the same machine.

2025 · AI

Now your ideas can go further.

AI helps you cross disciplines, explore, and make. You choose the direction.
